title:
Buffalo Bill shoots to kill,
 Never missed nor he never will.
html_source:
Buffalo Bill was an American scout, bison hunter, and showman, one of the most colourful figures of the Old West.

Clearly, Simon Dedalus is being paralleled with the American mythology of the cowboy. A very thin fabrication
